description: Request bytes -> accepted (with the canonical encoding of the decoded request) or an error.

vectors.name: query may carry a requestId
vectors.why: reads ignore it, as ts-db-go does

vectors.name: every mutation op
vectors.why: the full v1 vocabulary in one request

vectors.name: $ref inside an array value
vectors.why: a reference may sit anywhere in a value tree

vectors.name: whitespace and member order are not significant
vectors.why: the canonical form sorts members and drops whitespace

vectors.name: limit 0 decodes
vectors.why: the limit range is the compiler's rule (CompileError)

vectors.name: limit 10.0
vectors.why: a number literal is its value: 10.0 is 10

vectors.name: 64-byte ids
vectors.why: on point of the id length

vectors.name: unicode text
vectors.why: non-ASCII and astral characters are ordinary text

vectors.name: body at the cap
vectors.why: on point: exactly 65536 bytes is accepted

vectors.name: U+0000 in a filter value decodes
vectors.why: NUL is refused at execution (SchemaError on the field), not by decode

vectors.name: byte-order mark
vectors.why: a BOM is not JSON whitespace

vectors.name: duplicate member
vectors.why: JSON.parse keeps the last; the protocol refuses rather than guess

vectors.name: duplicate member inside an op
vectors.why: the path names the duplicate; op names its index

vectors.name: lone surrogate
vectors.why: Go would read it as U+FFFD; refusing keeps both sides equal

vectors.name: v "1"
vectors.why: a string is not the number 1

vectors.name: 65-byte tenant
vectors.why: off point of the id length

vectors.name: mutation without requestId
vectors.why: a mutation's idempotency key is required

vectors.name: query containing an insert
vectors.why: a query may contain only select and get

vectors.name: filter without value
vectors.why: value is required (null is a value)

vectors.name: insert id uppercase
vectors.why: canonical lowercase only, so one id has one spelling

vectors.name: $ref to itself
vectors.why: an op cannot use its own result

vectors.name: $ref in a query
vectors.why: a query has no inserts to reference

vectors.name: empty expect
vectors.why: an expect states at least one check

vectors.name: expect version 2^53
vectors.why: off point of the safe-integer range

vectors.name: patch expecting absence
vectors.why: a patch of a missing document can never succeed

vectors.name: empty expect.fields
vectors.why: fields names at least one field

vectors.name: unknown expect member
vectors.why: strict decode; range is reserved for v1.1

vectors.name: integer literal above 2^53
vectors.why: a literal is its double value: 9007199254740993 reads as 9007199254740992

vectors.name: expect version 9007199254740993
vectors.why: reads as 2^53, which is not a safe integer

vectors.name: number underflow
vectors.why: 1e-400 is finite after rounding: it reads as 0

vectors.name: 64 containers, empty innermost
vectors.why: on point of the nesting limit

vectors.name: 64 containers, non-empty innermost
vectors.why: scalars do not count as nesting

vectors.name: 65 containers, empty innermost
vectors.why: off point: the 65th container is refused at its own path

vectors.name: lone surrogate in a member name
vectors.why: names are text too; the path names the member (not compared here: a lone surrogate cannot survive a Go string)

vectors.name: duplicate member spelled with an escape
vectors.why: names compare after unescaping: \u006bind is kind

vectors.name: object in an id position
vectors.why: an object without $ref is not an id

vectors.name: array in an id position
vectors.why: an array is not an id
